scripts.build:viewer: npm run typecheck && esbuild pipeline/viewer/build.ts --bundle --platform=node --packages=external --format=esm --outfile=pipeline/viewer/dist/build.mjs && node pipeline/viewer/dist/build.mjs
scripts.build:matcher: npm run typecheck && esbuild pipeline/manual_matcher/build.ts --bundle --platform=node --packages=external --format=esm --outfile=output/manual-matcher-build.mjs && node output/manual-matcher-build.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "pipeline/viewer/src/**/*.ts" "pipeline/viewer/*.ts" "tests/viewer/**/*.ts" playwright.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json pipeline/viewer/index.html pipeline/viewer/styles.css
